notes.title: Winter Update is Out Now!
notes.notes:
It's hard to believe that it's already been four months since [b]Othello Let's go[/b] came out on Steam! We appreciate everyone who's playing the game. 

This Winter update includes:
[list]
[*] Winter graphics and UI
[*] Redesign the transition animations
[*] Fixed 'buttons not clickable in Lights-Out mode' issue
[/list]
As a side note, the game will be released on [b]Nintendo Switch[/b] by early 2021!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38453498/7febd6830b796c6da60dff5ba5ebcab2cfb0bc85.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38453498/5ab8ef4363546eccdbfd4d8472a8f7103dbaf380.png[/img]

- Studio Amateur

notes.title: Othello Let's Go now support Japanese!
notes.notes:
We are happy to tell you that [b]Othello Let's Go[/b] now support [b]Japanese[/b]!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38453498/9836f5e9b786bdf6a30d2699442c58380740ddc7.png[/img]

If you have any Japanese friends interested in it, please tell them this news!

Best Regards,
Studio Amateur

notes.title: Othello Let's Go 1.2 is Out!
notes.notes:
It has been two months since the last update, and we have made many changes to improve the game experience during this period.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38453498/2a76fb39ffb5a34b323d05468c1e9cc125a537be.png[/img]
[list]
[*] Accessibility options (e.g. [u]show last move[/u], [u]board coordinates[/u] and so on)
[*] Brand-new interactive tutorial mode
[*] Re-design buttons and Lights-Out mode
[*] More Endgame and Lights-Out levels
[*] Enable to skip the Intro scene
[*] Hotkeys support
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38453498/61bc65db0b9e420edbb224e4ab19f99670ec8714.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38453498/d9419eadb1514ca8880d6722fe90f7cffb389b80.png[/img]

We hope you enjoy the new update and the fixes make the experience better.

- Studio Amateur

notes.title: New Update: 1.1.04
notes.notes:
We've got a new update!

This particular patch brings you:

[list]
[*] Separated background music and sound effect volume settings
[*] Fixed the win and lose sounds issue
[*] Changed the soundtrack list
[*] Marked with numbers and letters on the side of the board
[*] UI and typo fixes
[/list]

- Studio Amateur

notes.title: New Update: 1.1.03
notes.notes:
Just a quick note: released a new update

[list]
[*] Improved the Championship (Level 7 & 8) AI, and reduced the response time on each move
[*] Added "Undo" button in Lights Out mode
[*] Verified and corrected the Minimum steps in Lights Out levels
[*] Fixed UI and text bugs
[/list]

- Studio Amateur

notes.title: New mode "Lights Out" is now available!
notes.notes:
Hey everyone!

Thanks to all of you for the amazing support you've shown since [b]Othello Let's Go[/b] launch! 

We've just released the new Single-Player game mode [b]"Lights Out"[/b]. This update also includes new achievements, soundtracks, levels and more!

We also plan to add more game mode and language support in the future! Stay tuned and thanks again for playing! 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38453498/f62cb1035290dfac082ea9bda4f8c29a924f7daa.png[/img]

- Studio Amateur

notes.title: Othello Let's Go is available on Mac!
notes.notes:
[u][b]Othello Let's Go[/b][/u] is available on Mac!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38453498/5dae7cae6f4fa6d3d868d5422de41415531cc157.png[/img]

Othello Let's Go is a beautifully designed strategy board game for all ages. A total of 8 levels of computer AI difficulty, suits for both beginners and experts! 60 carefully selected Endgame levels are waiting for Othello master to solve!

notes.title: Othello Let's Go Will be Released on August 19th
notes.notes:
We are very excited to announce that [b]Othello Let's go[/b] will be released on August 19th!

Our normal price will be $1.99, we're going to do a launch discount of 10% ($1.79). 

A FREE major update will be released in a month, which includes:
[list]
[*] brand-new single player mode (lights out)
[*] expand endgame levels
[/list]
Thanks for being part of our community. Hope you enjoy the game!

[i]Studio Amateur[/i]
